PCW 'Still to answer' list (GapInbox, documented in the support article) is never rendered: grep shows no <GapInbox in apps/web/src. Slides show 'N to answer' in the rail but nothing says WHAT is left, so the user cannot finish a slide (Project and team stuck at '1 to answer' after name/code/dates/currency/PM/M&E/no-partners all done).

Project and team stayed '1 to answer' with every field filled (dates typed one after another via fill+Tab). Re-typing the End date (different value, then same value) flipped it to Complete. Suggests a save race / stale view after rapid consecutive saves; the field showed the value and it survived reload but the requirement was not re-evaluated.
'There are no outside partners' checkbox: first click reported 'did not change its state' (control flickered back), later clicks worked. Slow/optimistic update on a controlled checkbox.

Donor/Sector/Country typed on Start slide just before clicking 'Read my documents' came back EMPTY once the read started (Country then only offered as suggestion 'Use Somalia'). Had to re-enter. Also the wizard created a second draft id after my reload (two ids seen).

From the proposal: Start/End dates (01-Sep-2025 / 28-Feb-2026), donor (CBPF/SHF), sector (WASH) and the doc's Outcome/Output skeleton were not extracted (only name, code, currency, summary, goal and 5 activities). Summary was taken verbatim INCLUDING the unfilled template placeholder '[insert target districts/regions]'.

Places slide: reading the doc gave 6 places incl. duplicates ('Baidoa District' district with no parent AND 'Baidoa' district under Bay; two 'Baydhaba' rows of kind 'not sure', one of them as COUNTRY). Needed manual removal of 3 rows.

Work plan slide: only one extracted plan item and its title was the placeholder 'Activity 1.1.1' (the doc's 'To be completed...' row); the 5 real activities named in the narrative (trucking, borehole rehab, latrines, hygiene kits, hygiene promotion) were created on Results but NOT proposed as plan items although the doc's workplan grid has Sep-Feb crosses. Indicators slide: extracted 'Female participation' (53%) but not the doc's real Indicator 1.1.1 'people reached' (target 13,500) nor the Women/Girls/Men/Boys targets.

Documented 'Links we suggest' (with reason + Accept all) never appeared after adding 5 activities; feed links had to be ticked by hand. Also indicator code for a second indicator was generated as 'IND1-2' (expected IND2).

Checkboxes (place / feeds / partners) only reflect the click after the server round-trip; Playwright check() reported 'did not change its state' every time though the value saved. Real users see a lag and may double-click (which un-ticks).

Results framework stays '1 to answer' although goal, outcome, output and 5 activities are all confirmed, parented and codes kept. Cannot tell what is missing because the Still-to-answer list is not rendered.

Data entry suggests/accepts a field FORM for IND1 Female participation (a PERCENTAGE rate) although forms are refused for non-SUM indicators; check launch report says so plainly (and that suggestion should not be offered for rates).

Budget lines read from the doc (467,290.00 and 32,710.30 — unambiguous US format with 2 decimals) were refused as unreadable amounts (2 amounts could not be read), and their currency was left blank although the proposal states $ / USD. Only the ambiguous form like 1,250 should be refused. Also line names were taken from section headers (G. General Operating and Other Direct Costs, PSC Amount).

Results framework: activity 'Belongs to' <select> has no '— none —/choose' option once a parent exists. With exactly ONE output the select visually shows it as selected although parentCode is unset, and choosing it fires no change event, so activities can never be parented to the only output. Result: slide stays '1 to answer' (results.chain) with no visible reason, sign-off blocked. Workaround: add a 2nd output, switch each activity to it and back, remove it. Fix: render a placeholder option (value '') and/or make unparented rows show it; also auto-suggest/assign when only one valid parent.
